description: Contract-win history for a GERMAN supplier/contractor (e.g. "Uniola AG", "System Strobel GmbH") across German OCDS tender notices (oeffentlichevergabe.de, CC0) — which buyers they won work from, award dates, and disclosed EUR values where published. COVERAGE IS GENUINELY PARTIAL: the winning supplier and award value are disclosed on only a small minority of German notices (below-threshold contracts routinely omit both) — the response reports won_count vs. value_disclosed_count so that gap is visible rather than read as "no data". See data_as_of in the response for the current coverage.

date_from.description: Earliest publish date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no lower bound.

date_to.description: Latest publish date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no upper bound.

sample_limit.description: How many example awards to include (default 10, max 25).

supplier.description: Supplier/company name, partial match, e.g. "Uniola AG", "System Strobel".

name: germany_supplier_win_history
title: Germany Supplier Win History
